summary: Immutep Limited furnished a Form 6-K containing its Appendix 4E preliminary final report and annual report for the year ended 30 June 2026. The filing discloses a net loss of A$79.3 million, up 29.1% from the prior year, with higher R&D costs and a $3.1 million non-cash impairment of an intangible asset related to efti. No special-situation transaction is reported; this is a routine periodic financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer.
